props.name: name
props.description: The column's name, used in accessible labels.

props.name: options
props.description: The value list. Leave it out to hide the "By values" section.

props.name: conditions
props.description: Operators to offer. `true` offers all; `false` or `[]` hides the section.

props.name: value
props.description: The applied filter, or null for none.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Shows the sort buttons. Picking the current direction again passes null.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Runs after Sort, Apply, Clear or Cancel, e.g. to close a popover.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the value search on mount.

examples.title: Column filter · sort, condition, values
examples.code: {describesFilter(value)} · sort: {sort ?? "none"}
